definitions.versioned_record_accession: Syntactically recognized versioned nucleotide accession in the original FASTA header, not a fresh registry verification
definitions.record_order: record_index is one-based original order within the mapped FASTA
definitions.sequence_sha256_uppercase: Each sequence is uppercased with layout whitespace removed; its bases are never exported
definitions.concatenated_sequence_sha256_uppercase: Original record order; no separator between uppercased sequences; corresponds to the historical feature extractor's concatenation convention
definitions.ordered_contig_sequence_digest: SHA-256 of newline-separated individual uppercase sequence SHA-256 strings, preserving contig boundaries and order
definitions.file_sha256: Exact original bytes, including headers, line wrapping, order and line endings; recomputed and compared with frozen canonical-source checksums

limitations: No genomes were downloaded or modified, and no sequence bodies are included in the inventory.
An accession-shaped header is not proof that an online record currently resolves or is byte-identical to this file.
Versioned accessions and per-contig sequence digests permit better retrieval checking; FASTA header text, wrapping, contig order, case, and line endings can still differ between services.
The original file SHA-256 remains the criterion for exact raw-byte recovery. Sequence hashes are separate checks and must not silently replace that criterion.
Only the 1418 phage/323 host training subset is inventoried here; independent external sources have their own accession manifests.
